**Final head:** `73b10f9b800e72f358f22f470e57a4531002c168`  
**Final tree:** `31c5a9a4b986820985658d3ed2228ebe9008828a`  
**Measured implementation:** `f4878302fd66975468dd307a94bb035529af5ecd`, tree `b5743bdb4b7a6c3e8fc6c1f8d331aa08ce21b719`.

The second commit changes ten documentation/evidence files only. All **754** staged application/source/runtime inputs were rehashed against the final worktree and remain identical. Production, tests, fixtures, runners, runtime binaries and dependency inputs have no delta from the measured implementation.

[Qualification and handover](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/73b10f9b800e72f358f22f470e57a4531002c168/docs/audits/2026-11-04-in-tools-361a-metered-drain.md) · [Evidence index](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/73b10f9b800e72f358f22f470e57a4531002c168/docs/audits/in-tools-361a-2026-11-04/evidence-index.json) · [Usage](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/73b10f9b800e72f358f22f470e57a4531002c168/docs/operations/in-tools-metered-drain.md)

### Executed results and review

- **Linux Godot:** 15 scoped routes, **12,026 counted assertions**, plus the genuine native failed-tick suite. Clean import, natural completion, no skips/runtime errors, unchanged sealed inputs.
- **Native primitives:** 30 cases, **14,023,753 repeated assertions**; all eight configured-four arms observed four phase claimants. Exact physical and separate IN-ledger parity, positional census and source/sink closure.
- **Parser/custody:** 23 synthetic/output-custody tests pass.
- **Actual Main/Rapier:** 148 assertions. Final metered FreeMass removes **1,561 units**, and ordinary v1's separately measured joined-census difference is **1,572 units**. These run-specific values are not replaced by earlier candidate measurements.
- **Protection:** six exact Water cells at 255 units beneath native body 1 remain intact at ticks 63–69 during native body-occlusion refusal. Wall refusal occurs in existing physical clearance before dispatch and creates no phantom native receipt.
- **Independent automated production review:** accepted for draft source review; no unresolved blocking source findings. Reviewer authorship of the separate native driver/runner is disclosed. This is not a human/account approval or owner integration permission.

### Hosted result at the final PR head

| Gate | Recorded disposition |
|---|---|
| [Documentation workflow](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/41833090400/job/126584971900) | **PASS** |
| Hosted materialized runtime provenance step | **SKIPPED because draft**, not a pass; local all-18 materialized check passes separately |
| [Native scope advisory](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/41833090216/job/126584970470) | **PASS, report only**; `candidate_native_execution_needed=true`, `native_skip_authorized=false` |
| Hosted Native, GDExtension/Godot and shader execution | **Draft-skipped**, not execution passes |
| Applicable scoped Water/actor and standalone metered native hosted execution | Outstanding before any authorized integration |

The hosted run is associated with head `73b10f9b`. GitHub checked out synthetic merge `a636e914468916b917f682f4947eec67a715f0fc`, whose parents are accepted main `7ef4856e` and this head; its tree is exactly `31c5a9a4`, identical to the published head. Hosted retrieval confirms frozen **32/32**, existing **156/157** top-five and **124/157** top-one; the existing LCB03 miss remains.

**Windows native/Godot, physical-device input, rendered pacing and owner feel remain UNTESTED.** Full #361-A acceptance remains open. No new native ABI, movement, momentum, pressure, shared coupling or equipment framework work is included or authorized.

Live main remains `7ef4856e`; #379 remains separately open/draft at `1aaab324`. #361 remains open. This PR remains open/draft with auto-merge disabled. No merge or issue closure was performed. Progress is recorded; implementation work is stopped.

</details>

### Retrieval and evidence integrity

[Complete fresh native/source/retrieval packet](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/pull/379#issuecomment-6632267280): frozen **32/32**, existing **156/157** top-five and **124/157** top-one, new #361 **6/6** top-five. Hosted frozen/existing artifacts independently reproduce every local question rank.

**USABLE02 retains canonical rank 5** at `reference/interfaces-and-message-contracts.md` → Physical equipment actions and results. Its interface/lifetime canonical targets and Current actor-usables authority are unchanged. ACT14 remains rank 1. LCB03 remains the historical miss; LCB08 remains rank 3 versus main 2, with existing MRR 0.8723 versus 0.8734. No query, ranking policy, expected route or threshold was weakened.

The dedicated #361 native test is outside the standard hosted Native matrix; its separate fresh compilation passed **16 pairs / 32 arms / 224 ticks per arm**, **215,237,704 repeated assertions**, 24-chunk/393,216-cell census checkpoints, five negative controls, actual four-worker participation, and distinct physical/IN diagnostic-ledger parity. All 56 compiled inputs match committed bytes; compiler/runner/executable custody passed. Focused proposal/runner tests passed **38+20**, policy tests **15**, material tests **99**. Native assertion totals predominantly reflect repeated census checks.

### Independent findings, remaining limits and changes

No new in-scope source blocker or correction was found. Current/Planned authority, Water units versus Brine cell counts, finite-domain boundaries, source inventories, M11 history, original fixture/source locks and historical audit bytes remain intact. All 18 runtime payload identities were materialized and verified.

The **registered shader v3 gate passes**, including unchanged positive bounds and negative controls. Its retained **v2 cross-backend finished-image diagnostic is FAIL**: 11 of 2,304 pixels exceed the original threshold in each nonzero-blend frame, maximum RGBA difference 0.3009393513. The accepted-main and candidate verifier bytes explicitly retain this as a diagnostic, not the v3 acceptance predicate. This task changed neither classification nor thresholds. Do not claim universal Linux/Windows finished-image equality. [Exact-head shader readback](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/41839882301/artifacts/13329645502).

Linux/Windows hosted evidence has its actual software-renderer/headless boundaries. It does not qualify physical target hardware/input, human feel, the proposed gameplay command cap, authenticated native gameplay-command receipts or #383 Liquid Drain. Material parity is metadata compatibility, not fallback physics execution. Native reservoir depletion is not crossing flux, and census checkpoints are not continuous full-domain observation.

Changes during continuation: Ready transition and PR evidence/status reconciliation; **zero source commits or pushes**. Missing pinned local companion files, LFS/index setup and extraction-only transfer sidecars were recovered without changing committed inputs or original artifact members; initial failed/held local observations were retained, and unchanged checks/readers then passed. The Linux coverage reader additionally required its recorded original checkout path; unchanged source was replayed there in an isolated worktree, without altering logs or predicates.

**Stop here. No merge or auto-merge. #361 remains open; #383 remains isolated and unmerged. Await a fresh explicit owner decision.**
